note: Forest Service campground at about 7,000 ft on the Western Divide Hwy (SR-190) in Giant Sequoia National Monument, near Camp Nelson, beside a meadow. Most standard sites are listed at 20 ft; only sites 31 and 32 (30 ft, reservable) and 29 and 30 (25 and 35 ft, not reservable online) take a 23-ft rig. Freeman Creek and McIntyre sequoia groves are nearby. --Claude
summary: rec.gov + FS read: $36 ($71 double, $8 extra vehicle), 30 standard sites, 26-ft turnaround limit, vault toilets + potable water, no hookups, 2026 season May 15 (first-come week) to Oct 24, closed for winter now. Only 4 standard sites a 23-ft rig fits (22 reservable ones capped at 20 ft). Not waterfront confirmed. New phone 559-745-4209.
